# IssueLens Assignment Policy

Assign IssueLens issues to the following individual owner. Preserve all current
assignees when making an assignment.

## Runtime And Protocols

- **Keywords**: invocations, responses, SSE, session, Copilot SDK, agent server, chat, automation, attachment, image
- **Paths**: main.py, chat.py, media_inputs.py, issue_image_context.py, agents/**
- **Owners**: @chagong

## GitHub Access And Repository Policy

- **Keywords**: GitHub App, installation token, MCP, label, assignee, repository config, issuelens.yml, authentication, permission
- **Paths**: issuelens_config.py, issuelens_config_tool.py, github_app_mcp/**, schemas/**, examples/**, skills/issuelens-config/**, skills/label-issue/**, skills/assign-issue/**
- **Owners**: @chagong

## Triage Behavior

- **Keywords**: critical, hot, blocking, regression, duplicate, classify, owner, notification, email, Teams
- **Paths**: agents.md, agents/**, skills/find-duplicates/**, skills/notify/**, .github/issuelens/**
- **Owners**: @chagong

## Deployment And Operations

- **Keywords**: Foundry, hosted agent, deployment, azd, Docker, environment, Key Vault, workflow
- **Paths**: agent.yaml, azure.yaml, Dockerfile, .github/workflows/**
- **Owners**: @chagong

## Documentation And Tests

- **Keywords**: documentation, README, example, schema, test, coverage
- **Paths**: README.md, SECURITY.md, tests/**, examples/**, schemas/**
- **Owners**: @chagong

## Default Owner

Assign `@chagong` when no area matches or when multiple areas match equally.
Historical assignment evidence may support this mapping but must not replace or
remove an existing assignee. If `@chagong` is not eligible for assignment,
report the routing recommendation and do not guess another user.
